'''Master Grinwell''' is a farmer who lives between [[Whitebridge]] and [[Caemlyn]].

==Appearance==

He is described as being a sturdy man.

==History==

He is the father of nine children, the eldest being [[Else Grinwell]].

==Activities==

Master Grinwell shelters [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Matrim Cauthon]] when they're on their way to Caemlyn in exchange for work in the farm. He loans them clothes and offers them the barn for sleeping, but [[Mistress Grinwell]] convinces him to give them Else's room.{{ref/book|1|31}}

At night, Rand and Mat play with [[Thom|Thom's]] instruments for the family.

==In the television series==
* In the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|TV series]], {{TVlink|Master Grinwell}} is played by actor {{TVlink|Pasha Bocarie}}.
